subject: Re: Mid-quarter portfolio triage — resource commitments & rollback plan
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Mike Daniels <mike@tidescale.io>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-q portfolio triage & resource commitments

Team —

Quick readout from my side as we head into QBR prep. We ran the portfolio triage this morning; highlights below and a small set of asks so we can lock the QBR narrative and the customer-facing timeline for TideScale. I attached a working action grid (midq_resource_grid.xlsx).

Status snapshot:
- Three initiatives on the critical path for H2: token-cache rollout, cheaper-quant inference build, and region-failover tests.
- Token-cache is ~65% complete; infra work is the blocker.
- Cheaper-quant: prototype shows parity for latency but needs validation on long sequences.
- Region failover: tests uncovered routing flaps on node churn.

Asks (what I need by EOD Mon):
1) Infra commit — who can reassign the additional 0.6 FTE from infra (estimated) for 3 weeks to unblock token-cache?
2) Eval runway — Naomi, please confirm which 10 customer prompts we'll lock for the week of Aug 16.
3) Customer communication — Mike, can we push TideScale a two-week shift on the non-blocking feature and keep critical bug fixes only?

Proposed fallback: If infra commit isn't available, we plan to cut the token-cache v1 from scope for QBR and present a roadmap with the trade-offs. I'd rather avoid that, but we should be ready.

Attachments: midq_resource_grid.xlsx (action owners + asks), QBR draft slide placeholders (in drive link below).

Thanks — planning to consolidate inputs around EOD Monday and put a single-page exec readout together.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q portfolio triage & resource commitments

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

- Infra commit: I can free up 0.4 of an infra engineer for three weeks starting Aug 9 if we deprioritize the regional infra sprint. That would require moving the regional test window by 10 days.
- Eval runway: Naomi — can you confirm the prompt set? If we include TideScale-specific dialogs we need at least 3 days for privacy review.
- Customer comms: Mike — appreciate the flexibility. If we shift the non-critical feature, we should include a note about the performance improvements coming next quarter to retain confidence.

If infra + a small QA pair are allocated we can keep token-cache in scope. Otherwise, I support the rollback plan.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q portfolio triage & resource commitments — commitments update

Sergio / all —

Updated commitments after quick sync with Eng and Eval. See attached small tracker (commitment_tracker.csv). Highlights: 
- Eng can reassign 0.4 infra FTE (Laura's offer) + one QA (0.2) if we defer the region test. That gives token-cache a 3-week window; delivery target Aug 30 for internal rollout.
- Eval: we've selected 12 prompts, including 3 TideScale-specific flows, and requested privacy review. If privacy sign-off comes back by Aug 11, we can complete the validation by Aug 20.
- Quant team: will ship a second round of long-sequence tests by Aug 18; current signal looks promising.

Risk callouts:
- If privacy review slips, we must postpone any public demo for TideScale.
- Routing flaps: infra said they'll throttle new regional routes during the test window to reduce churn — temporary but needs monitoring.

Next steps: Naomi to own eval signoff; Laura to confirm infra shift by EOD Mon; Aditya to confirm whether we can move the regional test window. I'll update the tracker with owners.

-Naomi

On Thu, Aug 6, 2026 at 10:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Mike Daniels <mike@tidescale.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-q portfolio triage & resource commitments

Sergio / team —

Thanks for the transparency and the proposed options. TideScale is OK with a two-week shift on the non-blocking feature as long as the following are true:
- We keep the critical bug fixes prioritized (confirmed)
- We get a private demo of the token-cache feature before any public mention (we'd like Jul 30 + 2 weeks window for internal testing) — if that demo slips, we want a firm date for the next slot.

One ask from our side: if the token-cache v1 is cut from the QBR narrative, can you include a slide outlining the staged rollout and an explicit customer impact table? That will help our execs explain the change.

I'll hold off external comms until you confirm the plan. Please confirm by EOD Monday (Aug 9).

— Mike
Mike Daniels
Head of Integrations
TideScale

Subject: Finalized asks + exec readout plan

Team / Mike —

Thanks for the quick turn. Consolidating outputs and next moves: 

1) Infra: Laura will reassign 0.4 infra FTE and 0.2 QA (confirmed) to token-cache. Laura — please update the tracker and tag the PR owners.
2) Eval: Naomi to finalize the 12-prompt set and push privacy review; if privacy sign-off arrives by Aug 11 we keep demo timelines.
3) Customer comms: Mike — we will delay the non-critical feature and provide the staged rollout slide you requested for your execs. QBR deck v3 attached; I pushed the latest single-page exec readout to the drive link.

Decision log:
- Keep token-cache in scope contingent on infra commit (now confirmed) and privacy review (pending).
- If privacy review fails, token-cache will be moved to the next release and we will present the rollback with the staged rollout slide.

Next milestones: 
- Aug 9 EOD: confirm all owners updated in commitment_tracker.csv
- Aug 11: privacy sign-off target
- Aug 16: dry-run QBR with exec readout

Thanks — I'll prepare the one-pager and send to the SLT before the dry-run.

Attachments: qbr_deck_v3.pdf, commitment_tracker.csv (updated).

— Sergio
